Contributing to fastDiversity

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thanks for your interest in fastDiversity. Bug reports, questions, and contributions are all welcome.

Reporting bugs

Please open an issue at https://github.com/eilishmcmaster/fastDiversity/issues and include:

  • a short description of the problem and what you expected to happen
  • a minimal reproducible example, ideally using the bundled data (data(example_data)) or a small simulated genotype matrix
  • the output of sessionInfo()

Asking for help

If you have a question about how to use the package, or about how a statistic is calculated, please open an issue. Check the documentation site and existing issues first, as your question may already be answered.

Contributing code or documentation

  1. Fork the repository and create a branch for your change.

  2. Make your changes. If you change a function’s documentation, edit the roxygen comments in R/ (not the files in man/) and run devtools::document().

  3. Add or update tests in tests/testthat/ for any change in behaviour.

  4. Check that the package still passes:

    devtools::test()   # run the test suite
devtools::check()  # full R CMD check

  5. Add a bullet describing the change to NEWS.md.

  6. Open a pull request describing what you changed and why. The R CMD check GitHub Action runs automatically on every pull request.

For larger changes, please open an issue to discuss the idea before starting work.
